name: Axway Software SA
summary: Axway Software SA, an infrastructure software publisher, develops, distributes, integrates, and maintains infrastructure solutions to enable optimized data flow governance in the complex organizations. The company operates AMPLIFY, a hybrid integration platform. Its AMPLIFY products include API management, managed file transfer, content collaboration, B2B integration, application development, analytics, and application integration solutions. The company also provides Axway Accounting Integration Suite that streamlines the integration between business applications and financial information systems; Axway Automator for the cross-silo automation, synchronization, and orchestration of job sequencing and services within a hybrid environment; Axway MailGate SC, which protects the network from attacks delivered by email, as well as secures sensitive data shared by email or attachment; and Axway Sentinel to discover, monitor, report on, and analyze data flows across the business ecosystem. In addition, it offers other products, including Axway Controlled Substance Ordering System; Axway EndPoint solutions; Axway Track & Trace; Axway Validation Authority Suite; Axway WideVision Alert; and Axway WideVision Service Health Check. Further, the company provides support, catalysts, consulting, and training and certification services. It serves automotive, banking and financial services, government and public services, healthcare, insurance, life sciences, manufacturing and CPG, retail, and transportation and logistics industries. The company operates in the Americas, the Asia Pacific, France, and rest of Europe. Axway Software SA was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Scottsdale, Arizona.
